nodes.powitanie.text.t: The ground has set into waves of glass, cold under your boots. Among the shards sticking up like broken teeth you can pick one of three colours: green, blue or red.

nodes.s_czerwony.text.t: You crouch and work a shard loose carefully, so as not to catch the edge. Red, cold as frost. Something flashes inside it, as if someone had looked in from the other side.
